description: Link a test case, test run, or a run result (instance) to a Jira issue (requirement / user story / epic / bug) — linked test cases are what give the issue its test coverage and traceability. Linking a result also links its case and run. Requires the Jira integration to be set up for the organization — otherwise a clear "set up Jira first" message is returned.

entity_id.description: Id of the case (ULID), run (ULID) or instance (number as string)

name: tm_link_jira_issue
title: Link Jira Issue
